title: Scent Selection
description: Blindfold your partner and let them smell three different scented items to choose the mood.

title: Scarf Stroke
description: Use a silk scarf or soft ribbon to lightly stroke down your partner's arms and torso.

title: Slow Collarbone
description: Kiss your partner’s collarbone five times, moving slower with each kiss.

title: Calf Massage
description: Rub a small amount of warm body oil between your palms and massage your partner’s calves and ankles.

title: Knuckle Ribs
description: Lightly trace your knuckles down the side of your partner's ribcage to their hip.

title: Warm Air & Cool Touch
description: Gently blow warm air on your partner’s stomach, then immediately follow it with a cool touch.

title: Fingertip Circles
description: Use your fingertips to trace small, slow circles all over your partner's upper chest.

title: Elbow Kiss
description: Kiss the inside of your partner's elbow for 30 seconds.

title: Nose Trace
description: Trace your partner's jawline with the tip of your nose.

title: Scalp Focus
description: Give your partner a slow, relaxing scalp massage using your fingertips for 2 minutes.

title: Wrists Elevated
description: Hold your partner's wrists gently above their head while kissing down their neck.

title: Back Scratch
description: Lightly drag your fingernails down your partner's back in slow, parallel lines.

title: Vacation Fantasy
description: Whisper a detailed fantasy about a vacation scenario into your partner’s ear.

title: Arm Feather
description: Touch your partner's inner arm with a soft feather or fabric from wrist to shoulder.

title: Behind the Earlobe
description: Kiss your partner on the sweet spot right behind their earlobe.

title: Interlocked Toes
description: Place your bare feet against your partner’s feet under the sheets and interlock your toes.

title: Timed Unbuttoning
description: Slowly unbutton your partner's shirt one single button every 30 seconds.

title: Hovering Lips
description: Hover your lips over your partner's lips for 20 seconds without letting them touch.

title: Under-Shirt Palms
description: Run your hands under your partner's shirt and rest your warm palms flat on their lower back.

title: Eyebrow Kisses
description: Give your partner a slow, gentle kiss on each eyebrow before kissing their lips.

title: Hip Pinch
description: Lightly pinch your partner's hip bone during a deep kiss.

title: Barefoot Sock Removal
description: Take off your partner's socks using only your feet.

title: Tongue Map
description: Trace an imaginary map on your partner's stomach with your tongue.

title: Pulse Check
description: Guide your partner’s hand to feel your racing pulse.

title: Warm Cloth Eyes
description: Place a warm cloth over your partner's eyes while you touch their hands and arms.

title: Lip Outline
description: Trace your tongue along your partner's lip line before giving them a full kiss.

title: Temple Thumb Massage
description: Gently massage your partner's temples with your thumbs while looking down at them.

title: Inner Thigh Kisses
description: Kiss the soft skin on the inside of your partner's thighs, staying away from the center.

title: Belly Button Ice
description: Use an ice cube to trace a ring around your partner's belly button.

title: Hair Brush Back
description: Have your partner lie back while you slowly brush their hair out of their face.

title: Chest Flush
description: Hold your partner by the waist and lift them slightly to pull them flush against your chest.

title: Favorite Feature
description: Whispering only: Tell your partner your absolute favorite physical feature on their body.

title: Off-the-Shoulder Kiss
description: Slowly slide your partner’s shirt off their shoulders, kissing each shoulder as it is revealed.

title: Chin-to-Navel Line
description: Trace your finger from your partner's chin down to their belly button in one unbroken line.

title: Lotion Hand Massage
description: Give your partner a slow 1-minute hand massage using scented lotion.

title: Ten-Finger Lock
description: Lay face-to-face and interlock all ten fingers while sharing deep, slow kisses.

title: Rear Shoulder Bite
description: Gently bite your partner's shoulder blade while hugging them from behind.

title: Contour Palm
description: Trace the contour of your partner's hip with the palm of your hand.

title: Three Warm Touch
description: Blindfold your partner and touch them with three warm objects in a row.

title: Throat to Chin
description: Lick a slow path from the base of your partner's throat up to their chin.

title: Five Lip Kisses
description: Hold your partner's face in both hands and give them five short, sweet kisses on the lips.

title: Behind the Knees
description: Run your fingers lightly across the back of your partner's knees.

title: Secret Praise
description: Whisper a secret compliment that you’ve never told anyone else.

title: Neck Press
description: Press your lips to the side of your partner's neck and hold them there while taking a deep breath.

title: Armpit to Hip
description: Lightly skim your palm down your partner's side from armpit to hip.

title: Heartbeat Listen
description: Rest your head on your partner's chest and listen to their breathing for 1 minute.

title: Bottom Lip Tug
description: Use your lips to gently tug on your partner's bottom lip three times.

title: Blind Body Guess
description: Put a blindfold on your partner and let them guess which part of your body is touching theirs.

title: Cheekbone Thumb
description: Trace your thumbs over your partner's cheekbones while kissing them softly.

title: Relax Command
description: Gently stroke your partner's sides while whispering 'relax into me.'
